Method of Attack: Used as a dependency by other malicious components. Downloaded a Bash script from a GitHub repository and ran a cryptominer called 'Ubqminer' on the compromised machine.
Indicators of Compromise: The script's role was to run a cryptominer called 'Ubqminer' on the compromised machine. The malware author replaced the default Kryptex wallet address with their own to mine for Ubiq cryptocurrency (UBQ).
